links.comparator_used: Original multi-FQHC model applied/recalibrated as-is in the single large FQHC, versus redevelopment on that FQHC's local data
links.outcome: Discrimination (c-statistic) for predicting colonoscopy completion after abnormal FIT
links.effect: Original model c-statistic fell from 0.66 to 0.61 on recalibration in the single FQHC (failed recalibration); redeveloped local model c-statistic 0.65
links.quote: The model was redeveloped in the same FQHC in a cohort of 1401 patients with a c-statistic of 0.65.
